edges: The defendant contends that the vehicle was not immobile when the stop occurred.
The defendant asserts that the vehicle had been constructively impounded by the police.
The defendant argues that any exigency justifying the automobile exception was extinguished when he and Johnson were arrested.
The defendant asserts that both the car and its contents had been seized.
The defendant argues that his sentences should run concurrently as they involved similar conduct.
The defendant claims that the convictions should be considered multiple counts of the same case for sentencing purposes.
